d: NorthEast United FC were held to a 1-1 draw by Sporting Delhi in a historic Indian Super League match at the Khuman Lampak Main Stadium in Imphal, the first ISL fixture ever hosted in Manipur. Sporting Delhi struck early through Mohammed Aimen in the fifth minute, but Antonio Moyano restored parity for the Highlanders before the half-hour mark. NorthEast dominated large spells of the second half and came close to finding a winner, with Alaaeddine Ajaraie hitting the post and later seeing a goal ruled out following a VAR review.
